reasoning: Round 2. Started from my round-1 set and the supervisor's slice. Accepted: (1) the peer median must be on one EV basis from the 5 genuine peers, not 9 incl. MCU incumbents; I re-derived CEVA and AMBA on EV from StockAnalysis statistics [43,44] (4.34x, 5.52x), median 4.34x, own 4.86x, k = 0.8 -> 4.75x (round 1 5.06x); (2) the H1 2026 inventory/receivable build does not show sell-in: the supervisor verified the inventory is Ambiq's own and purchase commitments rose 7.7 -> 32.2 [6]; I checked the 10-Q inventory note myself (WIP 20.8 vs 11.7, finished goods 7.3 vs 4.8 [6]) and the Q2 call (demand far above supply, thin distribution inventory, expedites [42]). model_inputs.ebit_basis_note: EBIT = company non-GAAP gross profit - non-GAAP operating expense - D&A = GAAP loss from operations + SBC + severance + IPO-related bonus and transaction costs - the 2025 non-monetary gain (Ex.99.1 reconciliations). Q2 2026: -8.727 + 3.557 = -5.170 = 15.989 - 19.374 - 1.785 [5]. The company's own non-GAAP figures exclude D&A as well as SBC, so its "non-GAAP operating loss" (GP - opex) is EBITDA-like; this set deducts D&A to keep EBIT an EBIT (engine ebitda = ebit + da = the company figure). EPS in notes = company non-GAAP net loss per share (excl. SBC and D&A, incl. other income) on weighted basic shares, the basis of the guide and Street (StockAnalysis/Benzinga). Engine model EPS = EBIT / diluted shares (no other income) and is lower; Zacks figures are on a different, GAAP-like basis.
